newsitem.title: FRANCE: Peugeot forwarding unit signs F.East joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot forwarding unit signs F.East joint venture.

text.p: Gefco, forwarding arm of French automobile group Peugeot-Citroen, said it signed a joint-venture agreement in the Far East with its German counterpart, Johann Birkart & Co Gmbh of Aschaffenburg.

"The joint-venture, based in Hong Kong, and trading as Gefco-Birkart JV Ltd, will give us the means to develop our air and ocean freight activities in Hong Kong, Singapore and all the Far East where Birkart has a solid network," a Gefco official told Reuters.
Gefco recently opened a sales office in Buenos Aires and also has offices in New York, Beijing and Tunis.
"Air and ocean freight forwarding represents only a small part of Gefco's business but we do have ambitions in these sector and our objective is to be present in the major markets."
Gefco's airfreight division generated around 11,000 tonnes of traffic in 1996, with Paris Charles de Gaulle handling some 6,500 tonnes and Basle-Mulhouse airport 3,500 tonnes, the official added.
"Last year's airfreight volume was similar to 1995 while turnover from the overseas division (air and ocean freight) was stable too, this having totalled 352 million francs in 1995."
Gefco's 1996 global turnover is likely to show an increase on the 7.41 billion francs it tabled in 1995, the official added.
Gefco's principal activity is intra-European road-based freight forwarding.
